title: Limiting the Spread of Fake News on Social Media Platforms by Evaluating Users' Trustworthiness
reasoning: The paper presents a system (CREDULIX) for detecting and limiting the spread of fake news on social media. While the topic of fake news has societal and ethical implications, the paper's core focus is on the technical implementation, a Bayesian model, and the performance evaluation of this system. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
